name: cache-boom
description: Plays an explosion above the prompt when a model call misses the prompt cache or writes a lot to it

missMinWriteTokens.title: Cache miss threshold (tokens)
missMinWriteTokens.description: A call that writes at least this many tokens to the cache, and writes more than it reads, counts as a miss.

hugeWriteTokens.title: Huge write threshold (tokens)
hugeWriteTokens.description: A call that writes at least this many tokens to the cache explodes even when the cache was warm.

labelLingerSeconds.title: Label time after the explosion (seconds)
labelLingerSeconds.description: How long the BOOM label stays after the animation ends.
